svg.aria-label: Hey there, I'm Himanshu. Backend & AI engineer · Pune, India. Open to backend & AI roles. I build AI agents, RAG systems and the backend services they run on. For 8 months I worked at Upswing, a Pune startup making AI booking assistants for hotels. First as an intern, then part-time as a backend developer. I'm now in my final year of AI & Data Science at SPPU.
